documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers has transitioned from a trading-led model to a manufacturing-driven company following the commencement of commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management aims to scale manufacturing utilization to 100% by the end of FY27 and shift the revenue mix to a 50-50 split between manufacturing and trading. The company is focusing on debt reduction using internal accruals and plans to expand its product portfolio into non-textile industries. Despite global macro uncertainties, the company remains optimistic about domestic demand and its ability to pass on raw material cost increases. Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited presented its Q4 FY26 investor presentation detailing financial performance and strategic initiatives.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 50-50 revenue mix between manufacturing and trading.
guidance.quote: Right now, . Like it is in trading and manufacturing right now what we did as of now was 75%-25% that will become 50%-50% .

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA margins are expected to increase by 2% to 3% in the coming years.
guidance.quote: See as I've been already mentioned the basis -- basically when we are doing the manufacturing, naturally the profit margin is little bit higher in the manufacturing segment. So, overall profit margin you can consider it 2% to 3% will be higher in the coming years.

guidance.claim: The company targets increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and industry event participation.
guidance.quote: Targeting increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions (GMMSA, Knit Show) and technical seminars.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve full capacity utilization of its new manufacturing plant by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA margins can be expected to reach near about 50% according to production growth.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: Total turnover from the manufacturing facility at full utilization with 500-ton capacity is projected around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment is cautious due to global macro uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Global brands are increasingly diversifying their sourcing base towards India, supporting long-term demand.
demand_outlook.quote: With competing manufacturing hubs facing challenges such as rising costs, compliance pressures and supply- side disruptions, global brands are increasingly diversifying their sourcing base towards India.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving demand trends are encouraging the company to expand market presence and enhance domestic distribution.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market, particularly water-based and specialty formulations, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: Textile and wood coating markets are growing exceptionally, with expected growth of 15% to 20% in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% in wood coating.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add new machinery over the next couple of months funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has scope to expand manufacturing capacity by installing additional vessels for an investment of INR 3-5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commenced production at its 72,000 sq ft automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Our company has successfully commenced production at its a 72,000 sq ft state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commenced commercial production at its first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The facility is designed with utilities, cooling plants, and monomer storage capacities installed for further expansion without requiring more capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of INR50 crores for the manufacturing capex, INR30 crores is a bank loan and INR20 crores was funded through IPO for land and the rest from internal accruals and unsecured loans.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capex_expansion.claim: The expected payback period for the INR40 crores investment in the manufacturing plant is around 4 to 5 years.
capex_expansion.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs have been volatile due to global supply disruptions.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: Transitioning to a manufacturing-led model is intended to strengthen margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: Operational cost optimization efforts include branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and internal process efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: Reducing costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and improved internal efficiencies in logistics, inventory, and processes.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2% from 9.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q3 rose by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with PAT margin improving by 620 basis points to 12.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax also showed strong growth, rising by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.

margins_costs.claim: Basic raw material prices at the plant showed no significant changes in the last 2 years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

margins_costs.claim: Reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12% following the start of manufacturing for two products.
margins_costs.quote: We are still importing the rest of the products. We are importing wood coating as well. But still, even though manufacturing has started for these two products, our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at approximately 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's product portfolio consists of 128 textile printing inks and 70 wood coating polymer products.
orders_capacity.quote: Silkflex offers a diverse portfolio of 128 textile printing inks and 70 wood coating polymer products.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first two months of November and December after starting manufacturing, the plant utilized around 60% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's long-term term loan stands at INR30 crores and working capital stands at INR20 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: By December end, the company's net worth stood at around INR42 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The interest rate applicable on the company's short-term borrowings is 8.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate poses a currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Business risks include economic performance, industry conditions, competition, strategy execution, technological changes, and market risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

management_commitments.claim: Reach full capacity utilization of the Vadodara plant.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: Launch new products following R&D trials.
management_commitments.quote: Since sorry to interrupt, our R&D is also going on, so maybe within 3-4 months we can launch some new products also, so we may expand little bit with the capacity of the vessels also.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to selectively expand its market presence and domestic distribution reach.
management_commitments.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to reduce operational costs via solar energy adoption, branch infrastructure sharing, and logistics efficiencies.
management_commitments.quote: Reducing costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and improved internal efficiencies in logistics, inventory, and processes.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Within 1 to 2 years, trading and manufacturing revenue share is expected to be equal at 50% each.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
